blocks.content: Quiz: Where do you define actions in a Zustand store?
Tap an option below to answer:
Zustand does not require a separate file for actions. Everything lives together in the store.
Zustand does not require a separate file for actions. Everything lives together in the store.
Inside the same object as your state, right alongside it
Correct! In Zustand your state and the functions that change it are all defined together in the same object returned by create().
Correct! In Zustand your state and the functions that change it are all defined together in the same object returned by create().
In a reducer function outside the store
Reducers are a Redux pattern. Zustand does not use reducers.
Reducers are a Redux pattern. Zustand does not use reducers.
In the component that needs them
Actions live in the store, not in components. Components only read and call actions — they do not define them.
Actions live in the store, not in components. Components only read and call actions — they do not define them.
